field_principles.barrier_refinement: if no deeper level is reached, the concrete actionable refinement of what still blocks the re-induced L2 predicate.
field_principles.chosen_submitted_config: what was wired into SUBMITTED_AGENT_CONFIG (or 'unchanged' if null); must keep parity tests consistent.
field_principles.core_efficiency_baseline: 2.0074 -- the REAL per-level metric control (NOT median actions, retired).
field_principles.core_efficiency_best: the HEADLINE -- did per-level re-induction reach a deeper level and raise core_efficiency.
field_principles.core_solves_preserved: HARD empirical gate on {lp85,m0r0,sp80,vc33}; a dropped CORE solve fails the lever regardless.
field_principles.deepest_level_reached_per_core_game: best_level per CORE game per config -- the direct evidence of reaching MORE levels.
field_principles.efficiency_delta: core_efficiency_best - core_efficiency_baseline, emitted explicitly so a null (delta 0.0) is annotated, not a control==best TAUTOLOGY false-positive.
field_principles.false_negative_risk_checked: a null is valid only if the positive control passed.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal prefix; e.g. success: reinduction_<game>_reached_L2_core_efficiency_<n>_above_2.0074 OR complete: reinduction_no_deeper_level_barrier_refined_honest_null.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates -- offline arcade search/induction, no headline GGUF load (1s floor). If the LLM induction tier is genuinely invoked, declare live_llm_inference + add the model precondition.
field_principles.model_specs: names the inducer/model actually invoked (or 'offline_dsl_induction_no_llm') -- the methodology field whose absence false-flagged the .418 A2 as METHODOLOGY_MISSING.
field_principles.null_delta_methodology_note: present when efficiency_delta==0.0 -- states the equality is an honest no-deeper-level null, not a measurement bug.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: any new level reached must offline-reproduce to count.
field_principles.positive_control_passed: proves the harness can detect a real re-induction through a level-conditioned predicate change.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records resources verified; pre-empts missing-resource fabrication.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content-addressed hash catches silent corpus/model drift on replay.
field_principles.target_levels_sweep: the {target_levels -> (core_efficiency, deepest_level, core_solves_preserved)} table so the decision is auditable.
